card.name: Spelled-out numbers cut mid-way
card.fires_on: The first piece of a spelled-out number or fraction in English, such as fif, eight, tw or sevent, where the rest of the word (fifths, eighteenth, twelfth) follows.

modes.label: Fractions
modes.description: Start of a spelled-out fraction like three-fifths or six-eighths.
modes.example: excluding Indians not taxed, three<< fif>>ths of all other Persons.

modes.label: Ordinals
modes.description: Start of a spelled-out ordinal such as twelfth or eighteenth.
modes.example: Anglo-Norman invaders of the<< tw>>elfth built defensive strongholds

modes.label: Years or multiples
modes.description: Start of a number word followed by a time or multiple word.
modes.example: Facebook has been there for you since<< eight>> years

card.writes: It favors digit and number-fragment continuations and suppresses Chinese ten-words, so it adds the rest of an English number word.
card.plain: It fires when a spelled-out number or fraction has just begun and the rest of the word is still to come.
